name: @shailesh93602/idempotency-kit
description: Make write endpoints retry-safe and abuse-resistant. Zero-dependency idempotency wrapper (the Stripe Idempotency-Key pattern) + sliding-window rate limiter, with a pluggable async store (in-memory included; bring your own Redis/Postgres). Runs offline, fully typed.
author: Shailesh Chaudhari <shailesh93602@gmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
